challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Iraqi (Baghdadi) conversation of at least 10 lines about your work or studies and your plans for the future. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 8 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about profession using شتشتغل or شتشتغلين.
An answer naming a job or field of study.
A question about where someone works or studies using وين.
A mention of years of experience or year of study using سنين or مرحلة.
A future plan using راح or أريد or ناوي.
A mention of an ambition or dream using طموحي or حلمي.
The phrase إن شاء الله after a future plan.
A closing exchange such as الله يوفقك or وياك أو وياچ إن شاء الله.
